summary:
SpaceTime Explorers is an interactive educational platform developed for NASA’s Earth System Trend Detective challenge. It transforms NASA Earth observation data into an accessible and engaging experience through two parallel modes:

* Explorer Mode: Allows users to explore four environmental variables: precipitation, land surface temperature, vegetation, and aerosols through interactive maps, charts, comparisons, and city discovery stories.
* Kids Explorer: Introduces Earth science through three interactive educational games, followed by illustrated Discovery Cards that turn scientific information into simple visual stories.

Our goal is to make understanding Earth’s changes accessible to everyone, regardless of age or scientific background.

The project combines scientific data visualization, interactive web technologies, game-based learning, and storytelling to promote environmental awareness and make science more engaging.

Our vision: Explore Earth. Understand Change. Shape the Future.

Project Description – SpaceTime Explorers

SpaceTime Explorers is an interactive educational platform developed in response to NASA’s Earth System Trend Detective challenge. Its goal is to make Earth observation data easier to explore, understand, and learn from by transforming scientific information into engaging experiences for different age groups.

The platform offers two experiences that work in parallel:

1. Explorer Mode – For Adults and General Users

Explorer Mode allows users to explore four key environmental variables: precipitation, land surface temperature, vegetation, and aerosols. Users can select geographic regions and time periods, explore interactive maps, examine visualizations, and compare environmental changes over time. It also includes city discovery stories that transform environmental data into accessible and engaging information.

2. Kids Explorer – For Children

Kids Explorer introduces Earth science through interactive, game-based learning. Children begin with three educational games designed to spark curiosity and encourage exploration. After playing, they receive a Discovery Card that presents the scientific information through illustrated stories, engaging visuals, and simple language appropriate for their age.

Benefits and Intended Impact

The project bridges the gap between complex scientific data and public understanding. It makes Earth observation information more accessible to non-specialists while encouraging children to develop scientific curiosity from an early age. By offering different learning experiences within one platform, SpaceTime Explorers promotes environmental awareness, interactive learning, and a better understanding of how our planet changes over time.

Creativity and Innovation

Our main innovation is combining scientific data exploration with game-based education in one platform. Rather than presenting the same information to everyone, we designed two parallel experiences tailored to different audiences. The children’s experience goes beyond entertainment by connecting gameplay to illustrated scientific discovery cards, ensuring that curiosity leads to meaningful learning.

Tools and Technologies

The project was developed as a web-based interactive platform using the following technologies:

  • HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for the web interface and interactive experiences.
  • NASA Earth observation datasets as the scientific foundation.
  • Data visualization techniques for presenting environmental variables through maps, charts, and comparisons.
  • Interactive web technologies for educational games and discovery stories.

Factors Considered During Development

Our team considered:

  • Scientific accuracy and meaningful representation of NASA data.
  • Accessibility for users without scientific backgrounds.
  • Age-appropriate content and learning experiences for children.
  • Visual simplicity and ease of navigation.
  • Engagement through interactive exploration and storytelling.
  • The importance of making environmental knowledge available to everyone.
